list.name: home_id
list.label: Homes
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT home_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY 1

list.name: plug_id
list.label: Plugs (non-general)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT plug_id FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min WHERE dt >= date_format(current_date - interval '1' day, '%Y-%m-%d') AND plug_id <> 'general' AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})

FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) * ${co2_kg_per_kwh} AS value

                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))

panels.title: Standby Waste (€ in window)
panels.description: Energy spent by plugs whose hourly real power was below the standby threshold but never zero — i.e. devices left plugged in. Multiplied by the active tariff.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    home_id,
    plug_id,
    energy_kwh,
    avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf AS avg_w
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id <> 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
    AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN avg_w > 0 AND avg_w < ${standby_watts} THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END), 0) * ${tariff_eur_per_kwh} AS value
FROM hourly

SELECT
  plug_id AS metric,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS value
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN hour(window_start) >= 17 AND hour(window_start) < 22 THEN '2_peak'
    WHEN hour(window_start) >= 23 OR  hour(window_start) < 7  THEN '0_off_peak'
    ELSE '1_mid'
  END AS band,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy by Appliance over time (kWh / hour)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  window_start AS time,
  SUM(energy_kwh) AS value,
  plug_id AS metric
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 3
ORDER BY 1 ASC

SELECT
  plug_id,
  hour(window_start) AS hour_of_day,
  AVG(avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf) AS avg_w
FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                      AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
  AND plug_id <> 'general'
  AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
  AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Always-On Score – % of hours above standby threshold
panels.description: 100% means the appliance was drawing more than the standby threshold during every hour in the window. Low scores indicate occasional / low-duty appliances.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    home_id,
    plug_id,
    avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf AS avg_w
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id <> 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
    AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(home_id, '/', plug_id) AS device,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN avg_w >= ${standby_watts} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS active_pct
FROM hourly
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY active_pct DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Phantom Load Suspects – standby waste leaderboard
panels.description: Plugs whose hourly real power stayed above zero but below the standby threshold. Sorted by estimated wasted euros.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    home_id,
    plug_id,
    energy_kwh,
    avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf AS avg_w
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id <> 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
    AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  home_id,
  plug_id,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN avg_w > 0 AND avg_w < ${standby_watts} THEN avg_w END), 2) AS standby_avg_w,
  SUM(CASE WHEN avg_w > 0 AND avg_w < ${standby_watts} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS standby_hours,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN avg_w > 0 AND avg_w < ${standby_watts} THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END), 3) AS wasted_kwh,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN avg_w > 0 AND avg_w < ${standby_watts} THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) * ${tariff_eur_per_kwh}, 2) AS wasted_eur
FROM hourly
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN avg_w > 0 AND avg_w < ${standby_watts} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY wasted_eur DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Burstiness – peak/avg ratio anomalies
panels.description: Per appliance: hourly peak power vs average real power. Ratio > 3 suggests highly bursty load (e.g. resistive heating, motors). Useful for sizing and demand-response targeting.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT
    home_id,
    plug_id,
    avg_voltage * avg_current * avg_pf AS avg_w,
    peak_power_w
  FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_10min
  WHERE window_start BETWEEN CAST(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}) AS timestamp(3))
                        AND CAST(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds})   AS timestamp(3))
  AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d')
    AND plug_id <> 'general'
    AND home_id IN (${home_id:sqlstring})
    AND plug_id IN (${plug_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  home_id,
  plug_id,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_w), 2)                                          AS avg_w,
  ROUND(MAX(peak_power_w), 2)                                   AS peak_w,
  ROUND(MAX(peak_power_w) / NULLIF(AVG(avg_w), 0), 2)           AS peak_to_avg_ratio
FROM hourly
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING AVG(avg_w) > 0
ORDER BY peak_to_avg_ratio DESC
LIMIT 25
